label: anthropic-sonnet-5
_note: Eight endpoints across Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock and Azure. Cheaper than 4.6 and the checkpoint the pipeline actually runs, so it is the one a diversification strategy would be applied to. Bedrock for the same reason as the 4.6 leg: first-party Anthropic is blocked by account data policy, and both Anthropic legs must share a stack.
